svg.title: Ziyi (Ellen) Zhou — statistician and data engineer, Montréal
svg.desc: A folio of pencil-and-watercolour plates of Japan that turn one after another: Fuji at dawn across Lake Ashi, a snowy evening below the Yasaka pagoda in Kyoto, the Togetsukyō bridge at Arashiyama in spring, and the Kamakura coast in summer. Beside it: Ziyi (Ellen) Zhou, statistician and data engineer in Montréal.

g.text: Kyōto · 八坂, un soir de neige

svg.text: financial tail risk, gaps in education data —
and build the software that makes those
UNESCO INSTITUTE FOR STATISTICS · M.SC. MCGILL · B.SC. HKU
